summary: Verra Mobility Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that its Board formed a Transformation Committee on June 5, 2026, to oversee a transformation initiative. The committee will support management's review of business and financial strategies, cost optimization, growth opportunities, capital allocation, portfolio composition, financing, and capital expenditure plans, and make recommendations to the Board. The committee comprises Raj Ratnakar (chair), Douglas Davis, and John Rexford. No specific terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. This is an early-stage strategic review. Watch for further updates on potential divestitures, restructuring, or capital allocation changes; no immediate risk-arb angle.
